title: Pitch invaders disrupt League Two game in ‘Gary Neville is a traitor’ flag protest
summary: Two men tried to plant flag of St George in centre circle Far-right group calls it protest against Neville’s ‘treachery’ Salford’s League Two match against Oldham was briefly disrupted when two men tried to plant a flag of St George inside the centre circle at the Peninsula Stadium. The men entered the field during the first half wearing white hoodies displaying the message “Gary Neville is a traitor” before being removed by stewards and police. Continue reading...
